units.name: second
units.note: Defined by fixing the caesium hyperfine frequency ΔνCs.

units.name: kilogram
units.definition: fixed by the Planck constant h = 6.626 070 15 × 10⁻³⁴ J s
units.note: Since 2019 no longer a physical artefact.

units.name: ampere
units.definition: fixed by the elementary charge e = 1.602 176 634 × 10⁻¹⁹ C

units.name: kelvin
units.definition: fixed by the Boltzmann constant k = 1.380 649 × 10⁻²³ J/K
units.note: Named after Lord Kelvin; 0 K is absolute zero.

units.name: candela
units.definition: fixed by the luminous efficacy of 540 THz light, 683 lm/W
units.note: Roughly the light of one candle.

units.name: steradian
units.note: Area on a sphere over radius squared.

units.name: weber
units.definition: V s = kg m² s⁻² A⁻¹

units.name: degree Celsius
units.note: Anders Celsius; same size as the kelvin.

units.name: becquerel
units.note: Henri Becquerel; one decay per second.

units.name: sievert
units.note: Rolf Sievert; weighted for biological effect.

units.name: electronvolt
units.note: Energy of an electron through 1 V.

units.name: light-year
units.note: Distance light travels in a Julian year.

units.name: parsec
units.note: Distance at which 1 au subtends 1 arcsecond.

units.name: barn
units.note: "As big as a barn" for nuclei.

constants.name: molar volume of ideal gas (273.15 K, 101.325 kPa)
